answer: In an agent economy, each agent posts a small time-locked deposit refunded only after honest epochs of peer-scored behavior. Every sybil needs its own bond, locked for weeks, so faking identities means fronting capital per clone and keeping it honest to recover anything. Like a meadow regrowing after grazing, honest work restores the bond; misbehavior burns it. Attacker returns hit a nadir when per-identity cost beats a fake vote's value. Since sybils spread from one funding root like yarrow, batch slashing that root collapses the cluster.
